accuracy_and_figure_reuse.basis: Fifty raw/native+HR label maps have exact values and geometry; all volume/context records and model choices equal.

rules.paired_speed: Same subject actual official wall / FNIT process wall, then mean/sample SD/median/min/max.
rules.stage_scope: Frozen ac692bb actual stage, no f436 stage rerun; fresh norm supplied conditionally. Official preprocessing excluded.
rules.raw_independence: Raw published T1 pipeline uses no official norm/finelabel input.
rules.timer_scope: Recipe/nested timers not added twice; official bilateral hippo/amygdala command counted once.
rules.na: No missing value converted to zero; planned denominators remain ten/nine.
rules.causality: Shared-GPU separate runs cannot isolate buffer/source effects from load/time changes.
rules.privacy: Only text evidence read, no image, asset, fit or GPU operation.
